description: SELECTION OF OPTIMAL ARTIFICIAL NEURAL NETWORK PARAMETERS FOR POWER SYSTEM OPERATIONAL CONTROL is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Shanazarov A.E., Worldly Knowledge Publishing Centre (Toshkent State Technical University, PhD, Acting Associate Professor). This article considers the processes of selecting and optimizing artificial neural network (ANN) parameters as a complex optimization method for operational control of power system states. The main goal of the study is to increase the efficiency of the power system in conditions of dynamic changes, ensure its stability and reliability. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
